scope: US-01–US-05 existing status view/page; no row/flow writes

timePolicy.noBaselineFreshening: Never substitute latestCheck or projectedAt for lastSuccessfulReconciliation

fields.label: Last source check
fields.meaning: When the source was inspected; this is not a successful import.

fields.label: Latest reconciliation attempt
fields.meaning: The latest attempt outcome; a metadata poll is not reconciliation.

fields.label: Last verified reconciliation
fields.meaning: Last completed reconciliation with readback; retain this date during holds/failures.

fields.label: Records in verified baseline
fields.meaning: Count at the last verified reconciliation; not the current source row count.

fields.label: Source version observed
fields.meaning: Observed source identity; compare with committed version, never expose as policy authority.

fields.label: Source version reconciled
fields.meaning: Identity of the source used by the verified baseline.

fields.label: Status display updated
fields.meaning: When this presentation row was refreshed; it does not make its baseline current.

fields.label: Reconciliation state
fields.meaning: Keep healthy/held/failed/unknown semantics; display freshness separately.

fields.label: Why this state is shown
fields.meaning: Retain underlying hold/failure detail even when the display is stale.

fields.label: What to do next
fields.meaning: An operator action, never an inferred identity decision or approval.

fields.label: View attempt evidence
fields.meaning: Render a qualified existing resource link; this native field is Text, not Hyperlink.

healthy.label: Source matches the last verified reconciliation

held.label: Source change detected—reconciliation held
held.explanation: Keep the last verified baseline. A successful poll does not resolve identity exceptions.

failed.label: Latest reconciliation failed or remains unverified
failed.explanation: Keep the last verified baseline; inspect the attempt before retrying.

unknown.label: Reconciliation state cannot be confirmed
unknown.explanation: Evidence is missing, invalid, inconsistent, unavailable or overdue; do not infer healthy.

freshnessLabels.stale: Status display is stale—last known state shown
freshnessLabels.unknown: Status display freshness cannot be confirmed

displayRules: Validate required evidence/timestamp presence, UTC offset and calendar validity before presenting healthy. Missing, future or inconsistent timestamps produce unknown.
Display projection freshness separately from Health; stale never hides the retained underlying held/failed reason.
Use the existing Health value and source/checkpoint/attempt evidence; do not create another monitor or identity decision path.
ObservedVersion differing from CommittedVersion, or an unresolved recorded hold, cannot be cleared by a successful metadata check.
A source check older than 90 minutes prevents a healthy claim; retain explicit held/failed evidence and show source-check overdue separately.
Missing/invalid projection time is unknown; projection older than 30 minutes is stale. Never invent a last-success date or count.

native-scheduled.label: Scheduled native automation
native-scheduled.meaning: Timing and enabled state need current runtime evidence; the manifest alone does not prove it is running.

native-interactive.label: Native interactive tool
native-interactive.meaning: Requires an operator action in the native product; not a scheduled service.

local-manual.label: Manual operator tool
local-manual.meaning: Requires the documented local/CLI workflow; a download is not a Teams execution button.

capabilityStateLabels.pilot: Pilot — limited qualification; not production adoption
capabilityStateLabels.live: Delivered — execution mode and current runtime state shown separately

capabilityStateRules: Technical lifecycle, executionMode and enabled/Off state are separate dimensions.
Display Off only from explicit configuration/native state evidence; never infer Off merely from pilot.
A completed pilot is not a production-live service. Existing manifest facts and dated runtime receipts must support each label.
Keep content approval, authority/currency and human role acceptance separate from technical capability status.

examples.expected: Source change detected—reconciliation held; schedule mode shown separately.
Delivered manual operator tool; refresh requires operator action.
Pilot / Off; do not offer a production-run button.
Unavailable on the checked route; no tenant-wide availability conclusion.

nativeRendering.clockStrategy: shallow UTC-epoch arithmetic with fixed UTC+10; no local-time getters
nativeRendering.nestedLoopCandidate: Did not render on checked native route; replaced
